elements.name: sodium
elements.funFact: Symbol comes from the Latin 'natrium,' named after natron, a naturally occurring sodium-carbonate mineral used since antiquity — not from the English name 'sodium.'

elements.name: potassium
elements.funFact: Symbol comes from the Latin 'kalium,' from the Arabic 'al-qalyah' (plant ashes), which potassium salts were historically extracted from — not from the English name 'potassium.' (Corrected from the list's repeated 'Na' — see _note above.)
